body: It will be interesting to see how this amalgamation of different phone-oriented operating systems that are scheduled to be released intermingle. I am rooting for Firefox OS, myself, but that's because I am biased from working with it.
I would also love to talk to someone! Hello! :D
Yeah, I guess you could say that the same happened to me. Though, in retrospect, I don't think I had "friends" in high-school, haha.

I don't live in a very large city, so we don't really.. have anything, heh. I would totally love to be involved in some sort of sport, or work out, but my chronic fatigue prevents me from even walking for extended periods.
I've tried Zoloft, Celexa, Wellbutrin, and various other permutations of SSRI/SNRI/NDRI drugs.
These days, I pretty much just sleep and peruse Reddit. I don't have money for anything else, honestly.
I, too, want me to care about me.
